mapper.select: SELECT l.*, s.* FROM (SELECT count(*) AS "lights", coalesce(sum(x.lamp_count), 0) AS "lamps", count(*) FILTER (WHERE x.status = 'In Service') AS "lightsInService", count(*) FILTER (WHERE x.status = 'Out Of Service') AS "lightsOutOfService" FROM theme.ops_streetlight x WHERE true ) l, (SELECT count(DISTINCT coalesce(x.gtfs_id, x.id::text)) AS "busStops", count(*) AS "busPlatforms" FROM theme.ops_bus_stop x WHERE true ) s
SELECT coalesce(nullif(x.${dim}, ''), 'Unknown') AS "k", count(*) AS "n", coalesce(sum(x.lamp_count), 0) AS "lamps" FROM theme.ops_streetlight x WHERE true GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 12

SELECT coalesce(x.gtfs_id, x.id::text) AS "stopId", max(x.name) AS "name", max(x.name_ar) AS "nameAr", count(*) AS "platforms", string_agg(x.code, ', ' ORDER BY x.code) AS "codes", ST_X(ST_Centroid(ST_Collect(x.geom))) AS "cx", ST_Y(ST_Centroid(ST_Collect(x.geom))) AS "cy" FROM theme.ops_bus_stop x WHERE true GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 LIMIT #{limit}
